summary: Phase 3 authentication testing completed. All backend auth endpoints (email/password + Google OAuth simulation) pass 100%. Frontend auth flows (signup, login, logout, persistence) work correctly. Anonymous-to-authenticated merge verified. Regression testing confirms Phase 2 features still functional.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/register with validation (short password returns 422, duplicate email returns 409)
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with correct credentials returns token+user
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with wrong password/unknown email returns 401
Backend: GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns user, without token returns 401
Backend: Google OAuth simulation (create user+session in DB, /auth/me with session_token Bearer works, logout deletes session)
Backend: Anonymous-to-authenticated merge (anonymous progress with X-Client-Id merges into user account on register, anonymous progress cleared after merge)
Backend: Owner resolution (authenticated user takes precedence over X-Client-Id when both present)
Frontend: /login page renders with Log in/Sign up tabs, email+password inputs, Google button (data-testid='google-login-button')
Frontend: Sign up with unique email creates account, redirects to /progress, profile button appears
Frontend: Login with dev account (player@chess.dev) works, redirects to /progress
Frontend: Persistence after reload (profile button still present, token in localStorage)
Frontend: Completing items while authenticated (Italian Game opening completed, XP increased to 120)
Frontend: Progress shows completed items (1 of 14 openings)
Frontend: Logout flow (login button appears after logout)
Regression: Openings list (14 openings), detail page with move navigation
Regression: Tactics trainer, Daily puzzle, Sandbox board
Regression: Global search (search for 'sicilian' returns results)

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (all critical auth flows pass, minor selector issue on home hero board)
